response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced polyglot Staff Engineer with direct, recent experience building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators, perfectly matching the core mindset of the role. While he lacks explicit Python experience—a stated must-have—his deep expertise in high-throughput distributed systems, strong TypeScript skills, and proven staff-level systems thinking make him an exceptional candidate worth interviewing.
strengths: Direct, hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic workflows.
Proven expertise in high-throughput distributed architectures, having engineered microservices handling millions of requests per second.
Demonstrated staff-level ownership and systems thinking, evidenced by founding a scalable open-source platform and developing custom testing frameworks.
concerns: Lacks explicit mention of Python experience on his resume, which is listed as a must-have technical skill.
Extensive historical use of niche languages (like DLang) might indicate a preference for custom tooling over standard industry stacks.
Does not explicitly mention participating in standard agile scrum ceremonies (e.g., scrum champion) despite utilizing agile engineering practices like TDD and CI/CD.
